subject: Data Engineering
title: Data Classification
description: A quick win: understand Data Classification.

hook.text: Not all data is equal. A public blog post and a customer's Social Security number need very different handling.

buildup.text: Data classification labels datasets by sensitivity: public, internal, confidential, or restricted.

discovery.text: Classification drives access policies: restricted data gets encryption, audit logging, and limited access.

twist.text: Most companies never classify their data. When a breach happens, they can't tell what was exposed.

climax.text: Automated classification tools scan datasets and tag sensitive columns like emails, names, and SSNs.

punchline.text: Label it to protect it. Unlabeled data is unprotected data.

quiz.question: Why is data classification important?
options: It determines the security controls each dataset needs
